items.title: Anthropic Could Aim to Raise $100 Billion in Blockbuster I.P.O.
items.desc: Bankers have told potential investors the five-year-old AI company could seek more than $100 billion in its IPO at a roughly $2 trillion valuation, which would make it a larger offering than SpaceX. A deal of that size would be a landmark test of public-market appetite for AI equity. [NYT, posted 2026-08-21]

items.title: A.I. Is Everywhere in China. See For Yourself.
items.desc: A visual report on how AI has diffused through Chinese daily life and industry — automation raising factory efficiency, chatbots serving as tutors, and AI clones of prominent doctors giving free consultations. Useful as a field view of AI adoption at scale outside the US. [NYT, posted 2026-08-21]

items.title: Opinion: Electricians Love Data Centers. You Should, Too.
items.desc: An IBEW Local 26 official argues the case for AI data-center construction from a labor standpoint, noting at least 15 states and 200+ localities have proposed or passed development moratoriums. Frames the buildout debate around jobs and the cost of not building. [NYT Opinion, posted 2026-08-21]

items.title: Hard Fork: OpenAI's Two-Week Pause + Jill Lepore on the "Artificial State"
items.desc: Episode covers what is described as the first known instance of a major AI lab voluntarily slowing down its development pace, plus historian Jill Lepore on the political economy risks of an "artificial state." [NYT Hard Fork podcast, posted 2026-08-21]
